name: Theremin (ceiling camera)
description: Full-body, two-handed control for a camera mounted above the player: distance between the hands is the main axis, and everything is smoothed harder because a distant camera is noisier.

mappings.name: Pitch
mappings.comment: Classic theremin gesture: pull the hands apart to bend up.

mappings.name: Volume
mappings.comment: Left hand height, like the volume loop on a real theremin.

mappings.name: Reverb Send
mappings.comment: Stand wide for a bigger room.

mappings.name: Note Gate
mappings.comment: An open right palm sounds the drone; close it to stop.
